column1: # The built-in question bank of the compliment polls (ほめ投票).
# One question per line: key <TAB> emoji <TAB> Japanese <TAB> English.
# Keys are permanent: they are how a question keeps its statistics and its
# "disabled by staff" state across releases. Never reuse a key; to retire a
# question, delete its line (it stays in the database, switched off).
# Rules for every line, checked by the tests in `polls/bank.rs`:
# - strictly kind: the answer must be a compliment for whoever is picked;
# - nothing that ranks looks, nothing romantic, nothing that singles anyone
#   out for something they did not choose;
# - school-life flavoured, for teenagers, in casual Japanese.
